description: Fetch the full machine-readable record (JSON-LD) for one object by identifier. Accepts sat-ids (sat:section:…, sat:pier:…, sat:vessel:…, sat:poi:…, sat:trail:…, sat:report:…), section slugs, legacy OSM ids (osm:node:…), Wikidata QIDs (wikidata:Q…), GTFS stop ids (gtfs:…) and Swedish AED-registry ids (shr:…). Deleted objects return a tombstone record with status "gone". Use this when you already have an object identifier — from search or an earlier response — and need its full record. Do not use for searching by name (use search) or for trip planning (use day_trip/plan_route).
name: fetch
